items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIII, List of Answers on Terminology 17:1
items.html: The Gevura of Atik is called Botsina deKardinus, and since the Sealed Brain clothes it — for the Galgalta of Arich Anpin clothes the Hesed of Atik, and the Sealed Brain clothes the Gevura of Atik, as is known — it follows that the Botsina deKardinus is concealed in the Sealed Brain, as above (in Answer 16). (Page 319, Item 58; Page 374, Item 169).
